meta.title: Yandex Tracker: tracked time
meta.description: Shows today's tracked time in Yandex Tracker at the top of the sidebar rail, turning green once 8 hours are reached; clicking the row opens a panel with today's and yesterday's totals and either day's worklogs, padded out to the 09:00-18:00 working day, plus an Add button for logging new time against an issue.
